final: WITH pg AS (SELECT pa.player_id, p.bats, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM player_award pa JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id GROUP BY pa.player_id, p.bats), ht AS (SELECT bats, SUM(cnt) AS hand_total FROM pg GROUP BY bats), sh AS (SELECT pg.player_id, pg.bats, pg.cnt, CAST(pg.cnt AS REAL) / ht.hand_total AS share FROM pg JOIN ht ON ht.bats = pg.bats), avg_s AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM sh) SELECT sh.player_id, sh.bats, sh.cnt, sh.share, sh.share - a.avg_share AS diff FROM sh JOIN avg_s a ON sh.share > a.avg_share ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
